# Awesome Agent Standards

> A curated index of standards, protocols, conventions, and emerging patterns for AI agents.

## Start Here

- [Introduction](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/intro): Project scope and entry points.
- [Harness Engineering](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/harness-engineering): How context, tools, control loops, safety, evaluation, and observability compose around an agent run.
- [Layers](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/layers): Conceptual map of instruction, context, execution, evaluation, observability, discoverability, and interoperability layers.
- [Decision Guide](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/decision_guide): How to choose the smallest convention for a project need.
- [Methodology](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/methodology): Inclusion criteria, evidence levels, updates, and removals.
- [Status Taxonomy](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/status_taxonomy): Accepted, candidate, watchlist, legacy, and deprecated maturity labels.
- [Emerging Patterns](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/emerging_patterns): Public conventions that still need adoption or specification evidence.
- [For Maintainers](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/maintainers): Practical guidance for maintaining an agent-ready registry.

## Core Convention Families

- [Project Context Files](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/project-context-files): Repository-root files that teach coding agents how to work inside a project.
- [Runtime and Guardrails](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/runtime-guardrails): Files and policies for scope, staged work, and safe execution.
- [Prompt Assets](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/prompt-assets): Versioned prompt files and formats.
- [Agent Skills](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/agent-skills): On-demand capability files and skill registries.
- [Design and UI](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/design-ui): Machine-readable design guidance for interface-generating agents.
- [Evaluation and Testing](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/evaluation-testing): Version-controlled evaluation files for agent behavior.
- [Observability and Tracing](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/observability-tracing): Semantic conventions for model, agent, tool, guardrail, and evaluation telemetry.
- [Web and LLM Discoverability](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/discoverability): Predictable public files and URLs for model clients.
- [Protocols](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/docs/conventions/protocols): MCP, A2A, and ACP interoperability boundaries.

## Full Snapshot

- [llms-full.txt](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-agent-standards/llms-full.txt): Compact Markdown snapshot of the main docs.
